topic: When we'll suggest seeing your GP

slides.headline: When we'll send you to your GP
slides.sub: Good care includes knowing when something needs a doctor as well.

slides.title: We work alongside your GP
slides.body: Physios, chiropractors and remedial massage therapists see lots of aches and pains that settle with movement and time. Some situations need a doctor as well, and we'll say so clearly.

slides.title: Signs that need medical input
slides.body: Fever with back pain, unexplained weight loss, night pain that doesn't ease in any position, or feeling generally unwell alongside pain are reasons we'll ask you to see your GP.

slides.title: Nerve changes worth acting on
slides.body: Numbness around the groin, bladder or bowel changes, or leg weakness that's getting worse need urgent medical care. We'll direct you to your GP or the emergency department straight away.

slides.title: When progress stalls
slides.body: If you're doing the work and things aren't improving over several weeks, a GP review can look at other factors, consider tests if appropriate, and talk through other options with you.

slides.title: It's not a brush-off
slides.body: Suggesting a GP visit doesn't mean we're stepping away. With your consent we can write to your GP, keep treating when it's appropriate and work together on your plan.

slides.headline: Not sure who to see first?
slides.body: Our team will assess you, explain what we find and point you to your GP whenever that's the right next step. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Why would a physio or chiropractor tell you to go and see your GP?

Most aches and pains we see settle well with the right movement, load and time. But part of a good assessment is recognising when something needs a doctor's input as well, like fever, unexplained weight loss, nerve changes or pain that doesn't ease in any position.

Sometimes it's simply that progress has stalled and a GP review can look at the bigger picture. It's never a brush-off. We can stay involved, share notes with your consent and work as a team.

At Hybrid Physiotherapy, our team is always happy to talk through next steps. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.

story.headline: When we'll suggest your GP
story.body: Fever, weight loss, nerve changes or stalled progress. It's teamwork, not a brush-off.
